basic_details.job_title: TMC Assistant Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (Tata Memorial Hospital), H.R.D. Department, a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, has invited online applications for 5 posts of Assistant Research Fellow on the Breast & Gynecology Study in the Department of Medical Oncology, initially for six months. The remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- p.m. Applicants need MBBS/ BDS/ BAMS/ BHMS/ BUMS/ Pharm D, and the age limit is printed as 40-Years. Applications are accepted only online until 07.12.2026 up to 05:30 PM (Indian Standard Time).

how_to_apply: Send your candidature through the online application only, at the link given in the notice: TMC online application form.
Submit the application by 07.12.2026 up to 05:30 PM (Indian Standard Time).
Give a valid email ID. All correspondence, including the interview date, is sent by email only, to eligible candidates.
If you have no experience, fill the experience column as fresher.
Make sure the application is complete, as incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

TMC does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of an application through the online route. For enquiries, the notice gives phone number 24177000, Ext No. 4664, and the email address [email protected].
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. If any candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. Receiving, downloading and printing the related documents is the candidate's responsibility. TMC is not responsible for email lost due to an invalid or wrong email ID, or delivery to a spam/bulk folder. The notice does not mention a travel allowance for the interview.

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre (Tata Memorial Hospital), H.R.D. Department
Initially for a period of six months

content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre, which includes Tata Memorial Hospital, is a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. This recruitment is issued by its H.R.D. Department (HRD (Project), TMH) for a study in the Department of Medical Oncology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: one-year clinical research experience is desirable. Preference will be given to experienced candidates. Candidates with no experience must fill the experience column as fresher. Age limit: 40-Years, as printed. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age or any age relaxation. The notice asks candidates to appear for the position only if all the required course certificates are completed and available. Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.qualification: MBBS/ BDS/ BAMS/ BHMS/ BUMS/ Pharm D

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- p.m. and the engagement is initially for a period of six months. Candidates may be offered a lower grade than advertised, based on their working experience, research track record and overall assessment at the interview and the recommendation of the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Assistant Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Send your candidature through the online application only, at the link given in the notice: TMC online application form . Submit the application by 07.12.2026 up to 05:30 PM (Indian Standard Time). Give a valid email ID. All correspondence, including the interview date, is sent by email only, to eligible candidates. If you have no experience, fill the experience column as fresher. Make sure the application is complete, as incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. TMC does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of an application through the online route. For enquiries, the notice gives phone number 24177000, Ext No. 4664, and the email address [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are initially screened, and called for interview, on the basis of the information given in the online application form. TMC reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called to a reasonable limit, based on qualifications and experience. Merely fulfilling the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called, and TMC also reserves the right not to call any candidate without giving a reason. In case of more candidates, a Written Exam/MCQ Test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly. The interview date is not given in the notice; it will be sent by email to eligible candidates. Candidates called for interview must carry original documents supporting the date of birth, qualifications, experience and the other details given in the online form. Applicants who fail to do so will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The notice names the Selection Committee members as Dr. C. S. Pramesh (Director, TMH), Dr. Sushmita Rath, Dr. Pallavi Appa Parab, Mr. C.T. Shetty and Mr. Yogesh Baswant Kembhavi.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. If any candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. Receiving, downloading and printing the related documents is the candidate's responsibility. TMC is not responsible for email lost due to an invalid or wrong email ID, or delivery to a spam/bulk folder. The notice does not mention a travel allowance for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Research Fellow posts has TMC announced?

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for TMC Assistant Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The qualification is MBBS/ BDS/ BAMS/ BHMS/ BUMS/ Pharm D. A PG Diploma in Clinical Research is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for the post?

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are screened on their online application and called for interview. In case of more candidates, a Written Exam/MCQ Test is held first and eligible candidates are shortlisted for the interview.
